title: 第25章 猎妖队第26章 战赵莽
content_zh:
晨光熹微，薄雾未散。
叶霄尘的院落中，十四道挺拔的身影整齐列队，每个人手中都握着自己的新武器，眼中闪烁着兴奋与战意
站在最前方的是叶龙，他手持那杆黝黑长枪，枪尖微垂，寒芒内敛。
他身形魁梧，眉宇间透着沉稳，虽面容略显疲惫，但眼神却锐利如刀，显然这几日的苦修并未消磨他的战意，反而让他气势更盛。
在他身后，护卫队一字排开，个个精神抖擞，腰背笔直。
他们手中的兵器各不相同——长刀寒光凛冽，长剑锋芒暗藏，开山斧厚重如山，玄铁盾沉稳如岳。
虽武器各异，但每个人眼中都燃烧着同样的战意，仿佛随时准备奔赴战场。
叶凡站在队伍左侧，手握一柄暗红色长剑，剑身隐有火焰纹路流转。
他面容冷峻，目光沉静，虽未言语，但周身散发出的玄气波动，却是让人一眼就能看出他刚刚突破玄感境九重不久。
而站在他身旁的叶寒星则略显焦躁。
少年握着一柄细长的青色短剑，指节微微发白，眼中闪烁着不甘的光芒。
他抿着唇，目光时不时瞥向叶霄尘，似是想说什么，却又强行忍住。
叶霄尘站在众人前方，目光一一扫过，满意地点了点头。
不错，看来这几日，大家都没懈怠。
他微微一笑，随后抬手一挥，
龙哥，你和护卫队的兄弟，待会儿随我一起去找三叔，加入猎妖队历练。
叶龙抱拳应声：
护卫队众人齐声喝道：谨遵少主之令！
叶霄尘又看向叶凡和叶寒星，道：凡哥，寒星，你们二人暂且留在家中，继续修炼。
叶凡神色平静，点头道：明白。

但叶寒星却忍不住上前一步，声音微急：少主，我……
叶霄尘目光落在他身上，早已看穿他的心思，笑道：怎么，你也想去？
叶寒星深吸一口气，坚定道：少主，我不想一直待在后方！
我也想战斗！
叶霄尘轻笑一声，抬手按在他肩上：寒星，别急。
他们这次去，是探探路，熟悉猎妖队的规矩。
等你们实力再稳固一些，我自然会安排你们出去历练。
叶寒星张了张嘴，还想再争取，但见叶霄尘神色不容置疑，最终只能咬牙点头：……是，少主。
叶霄尘满意地收回手，目光扫过众人，朗声道：出发！
众人齐声应和，随即在叶龙的带领下，整齐列队，迈步向外走去。
苏晚晴站在叶霄尘身侧，目送众人离去，眼中既有欣慰，又有一丝担忧。
她轻声道：少主，他们……真的准备好了吗？
叶霄尘负手而立，嘴角微扬：放心，现在的护卫队，可不是之前谁都可以欺负的软柿子。
——
content_en:
The morning light is faint and the mist has not dispersed.
In Ye Xiaochen's courtyard, fourteen tall figures lined up neatly, each holding their own new weapons in their hands, with excitement and fighting spirit shining in their eyes.
Standing at the front is Ye Long. He is holding the dark spear, the tip of the spear is slightly hanging, and the cold light is restrained.
He is tall and burly, with a calm look on his brows. Although his face looks a little tired, his eyes are as sharp as a knife. It is obvious that the hard training in the past few days has not diminished his fighting spirit, but has made him more powerful.
Behind him, the escorts lined up, all in high spirits, with straight backs.
The weapons in their hands are different - the long sword is cold and cold, the long sword has a hidden edge, the mountain ax is as thick as a mountain, and the black iron shield is as steady as a mountain.
Although the weapons are different, everyone's eyes are burning with the same fighting spirit, as if they are ready to rush to the battlefield at any time.
Ye Fan stood on the left side of the team, holding a dark red sword with flame patterns hidden on the sword.
His face was stern and his eyes were calm. Although he said nothing, the fluctuations of profound energy emanating from his body made it obvious at a glance that he had just broken through to the ninth level of the profound sense realm.
Ye Hanxing, who was standing next to him, looked a little anxious.
The young man was holding a slender green dagger, his knuckles were slightly white, and his eyes were shining with unwillingness.
He pursed his lips and glanced at Ye Xiaochen from time to time, as if he wanted to say something, but he held it back.
Ye Xiaochen stood in front of everyone, glanced over them one by one, and nodded with satisfaction.
Yes, it seems that everyone has been slacking off in the past few days.
He smiled slightly, then raised his hand and waved,
Brother Long, you and your brothers from the escort team will come with me to find my third uncle later and join the demon hunting team for experience.
Ye Long cupped his fists and responded:
Everyone in the escort shouted in unison: I will obey the order of the young master!
Ye Xiaochen looked at Ye Fan and Ye Hanxing again and said: Brother Fan, Hanxing, you two stay at home for now and continue to practice.
Ye Fan looked calm, nodded and said: Understood.
But Ye Hanxing couldn't help but step forward, his voice slightly urgent: Young Master, I...
Ye Xiaochen's eyes fell on him and he had already seen through his thoughts. He smiled and said: What, you want to go too?
Ye Hanxing took a deep breath and said firmly: Young Master, I don't want to stay behind all the time!
I want to fight too!
Ye Xiaochen chuckled lightly and raised his hand to put on his shoulder: Hanxing, don't worry.
They went this time to explore the road and get familiar with the rules of the demon hunting team.
When your strength becomes more stable, I will naturally arrange for you to go out for training.
Ye Hanxing opened his mouth and wanted to fight for it again, but seeing Ye Xiaochen's expression unquestionable, he could only grit his teeth and nod: ...Yes, young master.
Ye Xiaochen took back his hand with satisfaction, glanced at everyone, and said loudly: Let's go!
Everyone responded in unison, and then under the leadership of Ye Long, they lined up neatly and walked out.
Su Wanqing stood beside Ye Xiaochen, watching everyone leave, with both relief and a hint of worry in her eyes.
She whispered: Young Master, are they...really ready?
Ye Xiaochen stood with his hands behind his hands and raised his lips slightly: Don't worry, the current guards are not the soft persimmons that anyone could bully before.
——
